newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India sells Sept naphtha at NWE-$14/t to Petrobras.
newsitem.headline: India sells Sept naphtha at NWE-$14/t to Petrobras.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has sold 25,000 tonnes of low aromatic naphtha at $14 per tonne below Northwest European quotes on a free-on-board (fob) basis to Brazilian state-owned Petrobras, industry sources said on Monday.
IOC's tender, lifting from Bombay on the west coast between September 22-24, closed on September 5.
Dutch trader Vitol won the previous low aromatic naphtha tender for a cargo lifting September 8-10 from Vizag at $32.39 per tonne below Mediterranean spot quotes on a fob basis.
